native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 2.5, 'state': {'servo1': '0 degrees', 'servo2': '0 degrees', 'servo3': '0 degrees'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. At 2.5 seconds, all servos should be at 0 degrees after the initial 2-second hold.'}

test2: {'time': 7, 'state': {'servo1': '0 degrees', 'servo2': '45 degrees', 'servo3': '90 degrees'}, 'description': 'First sequence step. At 7 seconds, after moving from the previous position and holding for 2 seconds, servo1 is at 0°, servo2 at 45°, and servo3 at 90°.'}

test3: {'time': 11.5, 'state': {'servo1': '45 degrees', 'servo2': '90 degrees', 'servo3': '135 degrees'}, 'description': 'Second sequence step. At 11.5 seconds, after moving from the previous position and holding for 2 seconds, servo1 is at 45°, servo2 at 90°, and servo3 at 135°.'}

test4: {'time': 16, 'state': {'servo1': '90 degrees', 'servo2': '135 degrees', 'servo3': '180 degrees'}, 'description': 'Third sequence step. At 16 seconds, after moving from the previous position and holding for 2 seconds, servo1 is at 90°, servo2 at 135°, and servo3 at 180°.'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
